subs.name: How to donate
subs.replyText:
Thank you for your interest in supporting Panzi Foundation! The easiest way to give is through our donation page at https://panzifoundation.org/donate/ — you can set up a one-time or monthly gift, choose your preferred currency, and pay by credit/debit card, Google Pay, PayPal, or bank transfer (ACH). If you prefer to send a check, please mail it to: Panzi Foundation, 5185 MacArthur Blvd. NW, #708, Washington, DC 20016, USA.

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team

subs.name: Funding request (asking Panzi for money)
subs.replyText:
Thank you for contacting us. We review all correspondence carefully. Please note that the Panzi Foundation is not a grantmaking organization and is unable to provide financial support.

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team
